audience: People who want to start group homes
headline: 3 Property Questions to Ask Before Signing in Georgia
caption: Before you sign a lease for a Georgia group home, ask: Does local municipal zoning allow this specific care category, what fire suppression standards apply, and are there neighborhood covenants? audience: Home care agency owners interested in government contracts
headline: Government Contracts Will Not Solve Immediate Cash Flow
caption: Government contracts can scale your home care agency, but reimbursement cycles often lag behind payroll. Before submitting a proposal, verify your operating reserves can cover weeks of caregiver wages before the first payment clears. Comment CONTRACTS to review preparation steps.

audience: Nurses who want to start an assisted living facility
headline: The Pre-Licensing Payroll Trap Nurse Founders Overlook
caption: Texas nurse founders often underestimate payroll burn while facilities sit fully staffed awaiting regulatory survey visits. You must retain trained staff before admitting paying residents. Ensure your cash flow plan accounts for pre-revenue operations. Comment PAYROLL and tell me your target city.

audience: New home daycare owners who have already registered their business
headline: Your Pre-Licensing Home Readiness Checklist in Georgia
caption: Registered your home daycare entity in Georgia? Before scheduling site visits, verify designated child spaces, household member screening prep, outdoor perimeter safety, and emergency exit routes with state guidelines. Comment CHECKLIST to review your licensing readiness strategy.
